title: Known issues — Budget Transparency
about: Every problem a session could not solve on its own in the budget-transparency project, each with how to solve it. Owner's part is in the Start here list; the session's part is worked through in priority order.
quick_start: Thirty seconds: KI-03 — delete the old incubation branch on GitHub (one click, link in the issue).
Five minutes: KI-01 — download one budget data file (CSV/XLSX) from bundeshaushalt.de in your browser and drop it into this chat.

how_to_send.label: Data files
how_to_send.text: Download in your browser, then drag the file into this chat — or, if you work locally, commit it under data/ and push.

issues.title: Old incubation branch must be deleted by the owner
issues.detail: After the move (KI-02), the owner asked to delete the incubation branch from the origin repo. Verified safe on 2026-11-03: the branch's career history was first preserved on a new branch 'archive/career-history-aug-2026' (pushed), so only the four already-migrated budget commits become unreachable. The session cannot delete it: both 'git push --delete' and the GitHub API return HTTP 403 — the session's proxy forbids destructive ref operations.
issues.where: origin repo TK725/next-career-step, branch claude/german-budget-transparency-jr0s9o; PROJECT_BRIEF.md Provenance already describes it as deleted

you.do: Open https://github.com/TK725/next-career-step/branches, find 'claude/german-budget-transparency-jr0s9o', click its trash icon. Do NOT delete 'archive/career-history-aug-2026' — that one now holds the early career history.

me: Mark this issue done; nothing else — the archive branch and provenance note are already in place.
solve.done_when: The branch no longer appears on the origin repo's branches page.

issues.status: done 2026-11-03: owner created TK725/gov-budget-transparency; files pushed as a fresh initial commit (no shared history with the career repo); career-repo copy removed
issues.title: The project lives in the wrong repo — owner creates the dedicated one
issues.detail: The project sat inside the private career repo (TK725/next-career-step, branch claude/german-budget-transparency-jr0s9o). The owner decided on 2026-11-03 to move it to its own repo now (D4 always required this before going public) and created the repo himself.

you.do: Create an empty private repo at https://github.com/new and, if Claude's GitHub access is limited to selected repositories, add it at https://github.com/settings/installations → Configure next to Claude → Repository access → Save.
you.send: A reply in this chat: 'KI-02: repo is <name>'.

me: Attach the new repo (add_repo, push access), push the files as a fresh initial commit, adapt CLAUDE.md/GUARDRAILS.md for standalone life, clean the career repo.
solve.done_when: The new repo holds all project files with fresh history, and the career repo's branch no longer contains the project.

issues.title: Budget data files cannot be downloaded by an automated session
issues.detail: 2026-08-13: bundeshaushalt.de was blocked by the research environment's egress proxy. Re-checked 2026-11-03: the proxy now allows both federal domains, but bundeshaushalt.de (JSON API and static PDFs alike) and bundesfinanzministerium.de each answer HTTP 503 with a bot-protection 'Security Check' HTML page to non-browser clients. A browser session passes the check; curl/WebFetch do not.
issues.where: TRACKER.md #1 (hands-on data verification) — blocked until a data file is in hand

you.do: Open https://www.bundeshaushalt.de/DE/Bundeshaushalt-digital/bundeshaushalt-digital.html and use the open-data download (CSV or XLSX). Quickest useful version: one file, budget year 2025, Soll. Optional: also 2024 Ist, for the plan-vs-actual angle.
you.send: The downloaded file(s) in this chat, or committed under data/.

you.do: Optional, only if no CSV/XLSX download exists on the page: say which download formats the page actually offers.

me: Before relying on the owner: try the Dezernat Zukunft Haushaltstracker dataset (their downloadable scientific dataset covers every Titel, ~10 years) and GovData-listed mirrors — neither tried yet as of 2026-11-03; they may serve the same data without bot protection.

Once a file is in hand: inspect structure (Einzelplan/Kapitel/Titel columns, Soll/Ist), reproduce the official headline total for that year as a sanity check, record findings as RESEARCH.md Phase 2, close Tracker #1.
solve.done_when: One full budget year at Titel level sits under data/ and its computed total matches the official headline figure.
